testScenarios.name: Telesignal Single
testScenarios.criteria: COT=3, timetag delta <=1 ms, status change <=1.5 s

testScenarios.name: Monitoring Link Komunikasi
testScenarios.criteria: IED faulty/link fault spontaneous status with COT=3, timetag delta <=1 ms, status change <=1.5 s

testScenarios.name: Telesignal Double
testScenarios.criteria: CB open/close/invalid, LR/LRT/TCC transitions; COT=3, timetag delta <=1 ms, change <=1.5 s

testScenarios.name: Telemetering
testScenarios.criteria: COT=3, measurement error <=0.25%, measurement change <=5 s

testScenarios.name: Remote Control Digital
testScenarios.criteria: Control only in remote position; acknowledge <=1.5 s; remote status <=3 s; timetag delta <=1 ms

testScenarios.name: Setpoint RCA
testScenarios.criteria: Normalized setpoint command; feedback follows POAQ; verify remote-only policy and command acknowledgement

testScenarios.name: Control Tap Changer
testScenarios.criteria: Raise/lower command; control only in remote; tap movement received by master <=5 s; timetag delta <=1 ms

testScenarios.name: Sequence of Event
testScenarios.criteria: Gateway buffers at least 600 events, FIFO order, event replay after link restoration, random timestamp verification sample

testScenarios.name: Time Synchronization
testScenarios.criteria: Time tags observed at IED/BCU, gateway and master station should remain aligned; strict test uses <=1 ms delta where applicable

testScenarios.name: Pengujian Fitur Komunikasi
testScenarios.criteria: General interrogation, multi-master with 3 master stations, automatic switch over main/backup, bouncing delay, transfer file

metadata.profileIntent: Generic IEC-101/104 interoperability and FAT evidence workflow example
metadata.confidentiality: Public sanitized example. Do not use as a contractual project standard.
metadata.namingConvention: BAY TYPE + TYPE + MNEMO + optional LAB #
metadata.measurementNotice: CT/PT define nominal instrument ratings, NOT IEC TI11 full-scale or physical rated MW/MVar. Do not set Y endpoints from apparent power alone.
metadata.calibrationStatus: UNVERIFIED / demonstration only; never claim 1732 MW/MVar is RTU scale without RTU engineering database
metadata.presumedSvaRawEndpoints: X0=-32767, X100=32767 (symmetric zero; -32768 extrapolates, QDS OV unchanged)
metadata.evidenceLimit: CT/PT ratio, not actual analog IEC-101/104 SVA resolution and not actual P/Q simultaneity or physical transmission limit
metadata.notes: P^2+Q^2 <= S^2 at nominal balanced conditions; active and reactive cannot both attain +S in same physical state.
metadata.operationalGuard: Compare raw SVA and physical reference on multiple points/signs before use. Keep automatic commissioning disabled until operator approves endpoints.
